name: std::sig_atomic_t
intro: An integer type which can be accessed as an atomic entity even in the presence of asynchronous interrupts made by signals.

sections.title: Notes
sections.text: Until C++11, which introduced std::atomic and std::atomic_signal_fence, about the only thing a strictly conforming program could do in a signal handler was to assign a value to a volatile static std::sig_atomic_t variable and promptly return.

summary: An integer type which can be accessed as an atomic entity even in the presence of asynchronous interrupts made by signals.
